name: am-digital-research-environment/dre-seo
description: SEO metadata, schema.org JSON-LD, Zotero/Google Scholar citation tags, XML sitemap, robots.txt and Google Search Console verification for the Africa Multiple DRE Omeka S instance.

scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the separate suite against the Omeka installation in OMEKA_PATH.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix what PHP_CodeSniffer can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at level 6 against the recorded baseline.
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Regenerate language/template.pot and compile any language/*.po.
scripts-descriptions.i18n:check: Fail when language/template.pot no longer matches the sources.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI runs except the Omeka integration test.
